Process

A process that removes surprise.

Six phases, defined outcomes, fixed budgets and a weekly live demo. Here's exactly how a VOX engagement runs.

Defined outcomes

Every phase ends with a concrete artifact you can hold us to — a strategy doc, an architecture, a working demo.

Weekly demo cycles

You see real, clickable progress on a live preview URL every single week. No big-bang reveals.

Fixed budgets

Discovery ends in a fixed-price proposal. Scope changes are agreed before they're billed, never after.

01Week 1

Discover

We dig into your business, users and constraints. Interviews, analytics, competitive teardown and a clear definition of what success looks like in numbers.

Strategy documentSuccess metrics & KPIsFixed-price proposal
02Week 2

Architect

System design before pixels. Information architecture, data models, API contracts, performance budget and the tech choices that will carry you for years.

Technical architectureSitemap & content modelPerformance budget
03Weeks 3–4

Design

Motion-driven design systems and page designs that match the brand — tokens, components and prototypes your team can actually build from.

Design system & tokensFigma prototypesMotion language
04Weeks 5–9

Build

Weekly demo cycles on a live preview URL. The design system goes to code, integrations wire up and every sprint ends with something you can click.

Production codebaseWeekly live demosCI/CD pipeline
05Week 10

Launch

Load-testing, SEO migration checks, Lighthouse sign-off and a controlled launch. We hold your hand through DNS, analytics and the first spike of traffic.

Zero-drama launchSEO migration runbook95+ Lighthouse sign-off
06Ongoing

Grow

Post-launch care, A/B testing, content engine and optimization sprints. The platform keeps getting faster and better while you focus on the business.

Analytics & monitoringOptimization sprintsSLA-backed support
